copy.headline: Senator Cruz launches Saving Texas to win back the State House and some Congressional seats in 2028
copy.caption: Following the blue wave election in Texas, U.S. Senator Ted Cruz pledges to recapture the State House and some Congressional seats for Republicans after losing them to the Democrats in this year's midterm.
